name: Gemified Thrall
languages: understands whatever it spoke before; speaks only in fragments
bio: Captive turned gem-studded servant of the Underdark. Drawn to anything with gems in it.

traits.name: Gemlight
traits.desc: Sheds dim red light in a 10-foot radius. It can't hide in darkness.

traits.name: Hates the Unstudded
traits.desc: Has advantage on attack rolls against a creature with no gems embedded in it if another gemified is within 5 feet of that creature.

traits.name: Shatterburst
traits.desc: When reduced to 0 hit points, it bursts. Each creature within 5 feet makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 7 (2d6) piercing on a failure or half on a success. A wall cluster within 5 feet goes off too.

actions.name: Gem-Studded Fist
actions.desc: Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage.
